methods.label: Counting on
methods.explanation: To add \(2\), count two numbers after \(3\): \(4,5\). Thus \(3+2=5\).
methods.levelReason: Counting forward within 5 uses Grade 1 knowledge and fits the supplied Grade 2 scope.
